prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1128; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the claimant in connection with the rear-end collision described in the enclosed materials. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care for those injuries. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please confirm receipt of this request and provide the requested information within a reasonable time.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes the claim file, photographs, vehicle damage appraisals, repair records, recorded statements, telematics or event data recorder information, and any dashcam footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect these materials. Our client reserves all rights and remedies available under the law.
